title: Measurement Request (IR)
description: The intermediate representation all selection runs on. Both front doors produce it: natural language via LLM structured extraction (schema-enforced), standardized syntax via deterministic parsing. Design rules: (1) units are mandatory, never inferred; (2) hard constraints are separated from soft preferences - hard filters, soft ranks; (3) every field is tagged stated/inferred/unresolved in elicitation so the system never silently fills gaps. This schema is the dual of instrument_capability.schema.json: each field mirrors a capability-record field so matching is field-by-field feasibility checking.

unit.description: Mandatory. Normalized by the matcher (eV/keV, Torr/mbar/Pa, m/um/nm/angstrom, K/C).

bound.description: A required bound with hardness flag

max.description: Upper bound (e.g. spatial resolution must be <= this)

min.description: Lower bound (e.g. field of view must be >= this)

observable.description: WHAT the user wants to learn. Mirrors capability-record 'measurables'.

vocab.description: Grounded terms in the controlled measurables vocabulary

technique_hints.description: Only if the user named techniques. Expanded through PaNET subsumption at match time; a technique hint is a preference, not a constraint, unless marked hard.

element_specific.description: Must the measurement resolve chemical elements?

elements_of_interest.description: Element symbols; lets the matcher check absorption-edge coverage against probe energy range

tolerates.description: What the sample can survive. false values become hard exclusions against instrument requirements.

sectioning_or_powdering.description: May the sample be destructively prepared?

in_situ.description: Must the observable be captured under operating/reaction conditions?

requirements.description: Quantitative bounds. Each carries its own hard flag.

dimensionality.description: Point measurement, line scan, map, or volume

elicitation.description: Field provenance from the parsing step. The clarification loop is driven by 'unresolved': ask the question whose answer best partitions the current feasible set.

stated.description: JSON-path-ish field names the user explicitly stated

inferred.description: Fields the parser inferred, each with its stated basis

unresolved.description: Fields that matter but are unknown; drives clarifying questions

original_text.description: The natural-language request verbatim, if NL front door
